about_the_game:
The Supporter Pack contains a collection of DLC and goodies for those who want to go the extra mile to support the developers of Once Upon A Puppet:

  • Digital Artbook: Take a look behind the scenes of the game
  • Digital Soundtrack: The original soundtrack for Once Upon A Puppet
  • 3D printing model: Use the provided file to print your own Drev!
  • Two exclusive Drev skins: Be knightly, be regal
  • Golden Strings skin for Nieve: Pull the strings in style!
